tagline: Designer and global supplier of power semiconductors
hero_kpi_rationale: Introduction of over 100 new products in 2025 into a portfolio of 2,800 power semiconductor products, demonstrating innovation and the ability to meet growing demands of advanced electronics

kpis.name: New products introduced
kpis.explanation: Number of new power semiconductor products introduced
kpis.description: The company introduced over 100 new products in 2025, 100+ in 2024, and 60 in 2023

kpis.name: Patent portfolio
kpis.explanation: Total number of issued and pending patents in the United States and abroad
kpis.description: The company holds 949 issued and 64 pending patents in the United States, as well as 961 foreign patents

kpis.name: Product portfolio
kpis.explanation: Total number of power semiconductor products in the portfolio
kpis.description: The company has a broad portfolio of 2,800 products including MOSFET, SiC, IGBT, IPM, TVS, HV Gate Drivers, Power IC, and Digital Power products

kpis.name: MOSFET product expansion
kpis.explanation: Introduction of new medium- and high-voltage MOSFET products
kpis.description: The company introduced 33 new medium- and high-voltage MOSFET products for power and industrial markets, as well as 11 low-voltage MOSFETs for the communications market

kpis.name: Power IC product launch
kpis.explanation: Introduction of new Power IC products for computing and communication applications
kpis.description: The company introduced 38 new Power IC products for computing, communication, and consumer applications

risks.title: Industry downturn
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in the semiconductor market, which could have a significant impact on its operating results and financial condition.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market, which may make it difficult to maintain its market share and pricing.

risks.title: PC decline
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily exposed to the declining PC market, which could negatively impact its sales and profits.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical tensions between the United States and China could negatively affect the company's operations.

risks.title: Product defects
risks.score_rationale: Product defects could lead to customer losses, additional costs, and loss of market share.

risks.title: Supply chain risks
risks.score_rationale: Supply chain disruptions could affect the company's ability to deliver quality products.

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes could impact the company's operations and costs.
